# Popcode

> Popcode makes printed things play. Point a phone at a printed photo, painting, book page or card and a video or voice recording plays from it, right in the phone's web browser. No app, no account and no QR code: the viewer types a short web address (popcode.app/name) and points the camera at the picture.

Popcode has two sides:

- **Popcode (for everyone):** people make their own Popcodes from photo + video pairs and share a short popcode.app link. Popcode also sells printed products that play: photo books, calendars, board books, ornaments, photo mugs, framed prints and more. The first five Popcodes are free, and Popcodes on anything bought from Popcode are free and unlimited.
- **Popcode for Nonprofits:** a done-for-you service that turns a nonprofit's printed appeal, annual report, gala program or thank-you card into stories that play. Donors scan the photos and hear from the people the organization serves; after each story, buttons invite them to give, volunteer or sign up. The organization gets an impact dashboard showing views, how much of each story was watched, button taps and gifts, with no donor names, emails or IP addresses kept. Popular for Giving Tuesday and year-end appeals.
